headline: Moonshot AI Apologizes for Kimi K3.1 Pro Model Rate Limits
summary: Chinese artificial intelligence startup Moonshot AI issued an apology for imposing strict usage limits on its Kimi K3.1 Pro model. The rollout faced user backlash over subscription quota consumption and security oversight.
why: Moonshot AI is a prominent Chinese generative artificial intelligence developer known for its Kimi large language models.
